text: The cafeteria should introduce a plant-based menu as it aligns with the current nutritional requirements and offers a unique opportunity for the campus to explore sustainable practices. A live fermentation station would not only enhance the menu but also cater to the growing demand for healthy, sustainable food options. The evidence shows that the dietitian-reviewed rotation meets every nutritional requirement, and the live fermentation station would significantly reduce waste and increase the sustainability of the cafeteria. North campus has demonstrated consistency in demand after implementing similar menu changes, further supporting the potential success of this initiative.
